name: benchmark-ui
description: A static benchmark UI that reads an index and Bencher Metric Format reports

scripts.types: json2ts --no-additionalProperties -i schema/index.schema.json -o src/lib/index.gen.ts && json2ts -i schema/report.schema.json -o src/lib/report.gen.ts && biome format --write src/lib
scripts.check: biome check . && astro check && svelte-check --fail-on-warnings && vitest run
